announcements.title: Help Test Penpoint Cloud!
announcements.message:
I've been dreaming about this since I started building Penpoint: real encrypted cloud backups and multi-device sync, built right into the app, and we're almost there! Penpoint Cloud is fully baked into the core engine, syncing everything (yes, even your preferences!), and there's a new iOS and Android app coming right alongside it.

But before it goes out to everyone, I need your help testing it first. If you're interested in helping test this big new feature, head to the Penpoint Discord (link below). Once in, check the #announcements channel or click the flask emoji in the #role-request channel to grab the Sync Testers role. That will unlock the beta channel where I've already got everything set up to roll out our testing soon.

We'll test Desktop first, then the Minipen mobile app as it rolls out (thank you to everyone who's already been helping test that one, you're the best). No pressure though, if you'd rather wait for the finished version, that's totally fine too.

Hope to see you there!
-Joel

announcements.title: Penpoint Has Officially Launched!
announcements.message: Penpoint is now officially available for purchase — but your beta copy is yours to keep, forever. Free, no strings attached. Here's what's ahead.

announcements.title: Help Shape Penpoint's Future!
announcements.message: We hope you're enjoying using Penpoint so far! As we get closer to launch, your feedback matters more than ever. Please take some time to fill out our beta tester survey — it'll help us understand your experience and prioritize what comes next.

announcements.title: Welcome to the Penpoint Beta!
announcements.message: Thank you for joining our beta program in 2026! Your feedback helps us build the best writing tool for tracking characters, locations, and items across your stories. We've made huge improvements since launch - enjoy exploring!

announcements.title: Welcome to the Penpoint Beta!
announcements.message: Thank you for being part of our beta program!
